rule.title: Contingency Calculations for Determining Average Prime Offer Rate
rule.summary: Regulation Z, which implements the Truth in Lending Act (TILA), and Regulation C, which implements the Home Mortgage Disclosure Act (HMDA), provide for comparison of a mortgage loan’s annual percentage rate (APR) to the average prime offer rate (APOR) for purposes of determining the mortgage loan’s status and for reporting purposes. APOR tables are updated and published weekly by the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau. The Bureau is considering authorizing the use of contingency calculations to determine APOR values in instances when the Bureau does not publish weekly APOR tables.
